history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE — keep-or-drop decision needed. This is a CHRISTIAN (Baptist) church, not a Hindu temple. The best-supported referent is the Baptist Church of Mizoram (BCM) congregation at New Saiha, Saihatlangkawn Road, Saiha town, Saiha district (22.48872, 92.98006 per geocode; a place listing puts it at 22.489939, 92.985962), attested in Mizoram Kohhran Hruaitute Committee records as 'Saiha Baptist Church of Mizoram'. CSV TOWN ERROR: no 'Saiha Baptist Church' could be documented in Lawngtlai town or district; the documented congregation is in Saiha (Siaha) town, roughly 60-70 km south of Lawngtlai across the district border, in Evangelical Church of Maraland heartland where BCM is a minority presence. AMBIGUITY: the generic name 'Saiha Baptist Church' could refer to this New Saiha BCM congregation or (unverified) to a BCM Lawngtlai-Area congregation serving Saiha-origin members — verify locally which is intended before using coordinates.

name: Saiha Baptist Church
town: Saiha (CSV town 'Lawngtlai' is wrong; the documented church is in Saiha)
town_description: Saiha (officially Siaha) is the district headquarters of Saiha district in southern Mizoram, near the Myanmar border, and the principal town of the Mara Autonomous District Council. It is Evangelical Church of Maraland heartland; the Baptist Church of Mizoram has a minority presence there, with its Lawngtlai Area administration covering the southern region.

travel.airport: Lengpui Airport (Aizawl), the nearest airport; approx. 378 km to Saiha by road via NH 54 (verify).
travel.railway: No railway station in Saiha; nearest railhead not reliably published (verify) — candidates include Bairabi (Mizoram) and Silchar/Dharmanagar (Assam/Tripura).
travel.road: Approx. 378 km from Aizawl via NH 54, with regular buses and jeeps; Saiha town is connected to Lawngtlai by district roads (verify).

visitor_information.opening_hours: Sunday services are the norm for Baptist churches; confirm service timings locally.
